# Wiki category supplement

Public evidence collected 2026-10-22. Derived from OSRS Wiki contributors under [CC BY-NC-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/3.0/).

This exact-ID supplement adds organizational roles only. It never supplies raid recommendations, outfit completeness, requirements or upgrade rankings. Existing reviewed catalogue roles are retained. Unresolved fields, historical/unavailable pages and conflicting IDs require separate review. Category mapping is not a claim of individual manual review.

The reproducible rules are work/wiki_bank_category_rules.json in the development workspace. Full raw evidence, identity audit and mapping ledger are in outputs/banking-catalogue-audit-2026-10-22.
